status: isolated backend experiment; no production slider or new production write capability

operation.enable_condition: audioDescription checked off in the global sound scope before each write and during readback
operation.scale: signed audio-description level; not percent, master volume or external amplifier volume
operation.wire_set_value: preserves the validated existing integer or canonical decimal-string representation; both value and type require readback

admission: isolated com.ash.nativehome.proof identity only; normal preview rejected
own foreground card and no overlay before inspection and again before commit
one global, non-account, nonvolatile, visible and active descriptor per fixed key
exact signed range and on/off enable metadata; duplicate or changed descriptors rejected
description off and expected numeric value checked twice; bounded validation age
idempotent request performs no setter; non-idempotent trial restricted to one adjacent step
fixed category/key/value; no arbitrary settings, service URI, shell, helper or jail policy

rejected_packaging_cases: mixed numeric and pointer write proofs

OLED65C26LD.status: skipped at host preflight; required safe-test context unavailable, existing preference preserved

initial_g2_trial.reason: integer setter converted an original decimal string into an integer

regression.recovery: original numeric string representation independently restored before further testing
regression.fix: carry the observed representation through both setter and readback; reject representation changes between validation reads
regression.host_regression: both integer and decimal-string change/restoration plus stale-representation refusal

limitations: No shared numeric widget, native range editing screen or production slider has been enabled.
Readback proves the stored setting transition and restoration, not audible output, description mixing or live programme behaviour. Description was checked off before and after both writes.
The fixed setter has no compare-and-swap API. Repeated context checks reduce stale requests but do not establish atomic exclusion of an external settings writer.

Only one adjacent value and its original value were exercised on G2. C2 was skipped before installation because its safe-test context was unavailable. Exhaustive range, enabled-description and sound-output coverage remain unproven.
C2 production HDMI switching remains gated; this experiment does not alter the prior idle tuner restoration limitation.
LG Home remains the default; checked core hashes, picture/audio/source/last-input reads and retained app state were preserved. No reboot, boot hook, firmware or core component edit.
Raw descriptors, original/target household values, app inventories and detailed receipts remain private.
